modelManagementSubtitle: View built-in models and custom training models
builtinHint: Built-in models come from base_models and are only selectable by the current model_trainer flow. This tab is read-only.
externalHint: One custom model ZIP contains the training script and optional initial weights. The script loads bundled weights through a ZIP-relative path; without weights, it trains from scratch. Custom models run only in model_training_runtime, never in model_trainer.
